difficulty_reason: Conjugation descends the integral equation from the quadratic algebra to A[T]. The quadratic factor and Gauss’s lemma put the trace and norm in A. The squarefree hypothesis then controls the denominator of the second coefficient and brings the integral element into the given algebra.
